pages.title: A Tadpole First
pages.text: Raising the young creature connects animal care with lava travel.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Capture Stradpole with a lava bucket and feed Crimson Mosquito Larvae. The grown Straddler is hostile; its Straddlite makes the board. The board crosses lava quickly but sinks in water and destabilizes on collisions.
